comment: Hashes are FNV-1a 32-bit. MODULES ('kind':'module') hash the exact ModuleScript Source bytes. TEMPLATES ('kind':'template') hash a CANONICAL SERIALISATION of a GuiObject subtree (sorted children, whitelisted+sorted properties, attributes, tags; ViewportFrame 3D contents excluded) -- see docs/decisions/ADR-0005-instance-tree-hashing.md. tools/hash_shared.luau computes both inside Studio and marks template hashes with a trailing '*'. 'deployed' records the hash last verified in each Place; null = not yet deployed. Any mismatch between file hash and a deployed hash = DRIFT: stop and reconcile before working on shared systems.

MetaMath.comment: Added B3 2026-08-09 (AD-Gacha, Lobby). The algorithms the blueprint says to implement ONCE for every meta system: Slot(period, offsetSec) deterministic time buckets (rotations/resets agree across servers with no MessagingService and no stored state), RngForSlot(slot, salt), Pick(rng, {{v,w}}) weighted choice, PickDistinct. Cross-phase invariant 3 routes every reset/rotation through Slot(). PURE -- no services, no state, no config reads; the reset-hour knob is MetaConfig.ResetOffsetSec and is passed IN, which is what keeps this Place-neutral. NOTE the `salt` argument on RngForSlot: without it two banners sharing a RotationPeriod would draw the identical featured set forever. GAME DEPLOY PENDING -- deliberately NOT deployed there yet: nothing in the Game reads it until Phase D challenges need Slot(), so the Game reporting MISSING is the EXPECTED state, not drift. Deploy it (and flip deployed.Game) in the session that first needs it.

UIKitHotbar.comment: Kit CONTROLLER. ONE hotbar for BOTH Places so they look and feel identical (user rule 2026-08-06): same slot design, hover, press animation and locked/empty states. Each Place supplies only OnActivated -- Lobby opens the Units screen on that unit, Game starts placement. Always draws LoadoutConfig.MaxSlots slots; a slot is never hidden, only filled/empty/locked. GAME DEPLOY PENDING alongside Kit_HotbarSlot. 2026-08-06 fix: paint BG's OWN UIGradient from the tier too -- only the stroke's gradient was being set, so the slot background stayed at the template's authored red for every unit. BG's gradient and the stroke's gradient are DIFFERENT instances; do not merge the lookups. 2026-08-06: hover preview RESTORED (the first version of this controller dropped the popup the Lobby hotbar used to have). It clones the shared Kit.UnitPreviewTemplate, so both Places pop the same card. Only shown for a FILLED, UNLOCKED slot. B26 2026-08-16: MIGRATED TO Kit.HotbarSlotV2 (prior hash 616b06bf). The old two-surface paint (border stroke + BG's own gradient, and the long comment warning not to confuse them) collapses to ONE root gradient, because V2 has neither instance -- the hazard is deleted, not re-created. Adds UnitLevel (shown only when the entry carries a level, hidden otherwise) and hides PlacementPrice and Placed/MaxPlacement, neither of which has a live data source. 78328bb4 -> baec9162 SAME SESSION, caught by the B26 acceptance run: the UnitLevel write was setText(levelFrame, levelFrame.Name, ...), and setText does root:FindFirstChild(name, true) which walks DESCENDANTS ONLY and never matches root itself -- so it found nothing and left HotbarSlotV2's authored placeholder 'LVL 100' on screen for every unit, in BOTH Places. Now setText(btn, 'UnitLevel', ...) from the slot ROOT. A placeholder rendered as truth is exactly the class of lie section 8 exists to prevent; the assertion that only checked .Visible would never have caught it -- the acceptance harness printing the TEXT is what did.

RewardScalingConfig.comment: Difficulty->gold curve + the Insane item table (PlayGUI blueprint section 8). Added P5 2026-08-13 (owner AD-Game). SHARED because section 8 requires the Lobby's reward PREVIEW and the server's actual payout to read the SAME curve -- the preview must not invent numbers. It could NOT live in StageConfig.Rewards: the Lobby's StageRegistry is a hand-maintained MIRROR carrying structure only, with no reward table and no drift check, so gold numbers there would be two uncheckable copies. WorthinessConfig is the counter-example and does not apply (the Lobby reads worthiness as a STORED result; a pre-match preview has nothing stored to read). Owns the Game's ONE wire->t conversion, TFromWire: the wire scale is 100-1000 while the UI scale is 1-100 (ADR-0011), and confusing them pays maximum gold for a normal match. Clamps, never extrapolates. DEPLOYED TO BOTH PLACES since B20 2026-08-14 (AD-Integration): copied BYTE-IDENTICAL from the Game (6870 bytes, re-hashed in the Lobby to 1d789978), never re-authored. The Lobby's deployPath needed a new RS.Configs.Global FOLDER, which did not exist in that Place. The reward PREVIEW is still not wired -- StoryModeController's renderRewards() cannot express a min-max band and only re-runs on act selection, while P4 republishes DifficultyWire on every slider move, so wiring it honestly needs more than the one call AD-UI's canon allows: see docs/proposals/2026-08-14-reward-preview-wiring.md.

Every consumer looks up the root gradient with FindFirstChildOfClass -- DIRECT CHILDREN ONLY, because V2 nests UIGradients under UnitLevel/PlacementPrice/TraitIcon and a recursive find repaints the wrong one. THREE consumers: SummonController featured chips, IndexController codex entries, and AscensionController's dupe picker (the third was missed by earlier notes -- it reads UnitLevel). B26 AUTHORED CountLabel (user-delegated): v1's was a Frame while IndexController guards on IsA('TextLabel'), so the owned-count had NEVER rendered; V2's is a real TextLabel and the branch is finally live. NO ShinyBadge (v1 had one, AscensionController drove it) -- shiny is not marked on a V2 card. PlacementPrice/ElementIcons/TraitIcon render HIDDEN: they have NO data source (AD-Game + AD-Traits proposals).

No shared/src file -- the INSTANCE is canon (ADR-0005). *** THIS IS THE CROSS-PLACE ONE: BOTH Places' hotbars render through the SHARED UIKit.Hotbar controller, so this template can never be adopted in one Place alone. *** Rarity on the ROOT UIGradient, no tier border -- which DELETED v1's two-gradient hazard (border stroke vs BG's own gradient) rather than re-creating it; do not reintroduce a second paint surface. 'Placed/MaxPlacement' is a MATCH-runtime count: nothing feeds it yet so it is hidden in both; NOTE the '/' in its instance name means FindFirstChild, never dot notation.

templatesNote: Templates are under drift control since 2026-08-06 (ADR-0005). They have NO shared/src file: the Instance is the canon. Two safe ways to get one into another Place: COPY it (Studio copy/paste) and prove equality by hash, OR build it with an identical DETERMINISTIC script run in both Places and hash-match (used for Kit_UnitIcon).
